m: निर्-√ धा P. -दधाति, to take or find out, RV. x, 160, 4.

s: puM, (niDriyate'neneti । nir + Df + GaY .) niScayaH । “jAtiguRakriyARAM utkarzeRApakarzeRa vA sajAtIyAt pfTakkaraRam । yaTA । manuzyARAM brAhmaRaH SrezWaH । gavAM kfzRA bahukzIrA । aDvagAnAM DAvantaH SIDratamAH .” iti durgAdAsaH ॥ DArarahitaSca ॥
m: निर्-˚धार m. (Vop.; L.) taking out or specifying one out of many, particularizing, defining, settling, certainty, ascertainment.
a: निर्धारः, निर्धारणं — 1 Specifying or separating one out of many; यतश्च निर्धारणं P. II. 3. 41; V. 3. 92. --2 Determining, settling, deciding. --3 Certainty, ascertainment.

m: निर्-˚धारणीय mfn. to be ascertained or determined, W.

s: klI, (nirDAryyate iti । nir + Df + Ric + BAve lyuw .) niScayaH । nirDAraH । yaTA, nirdDAraRe zazwyAH samAso na syAditi durgAdAsaH ॥
m: निर्-˚धारण n. (Var.; Śaṃk.; Pāṇ., Sch.; Vop.) taking out or specifying one out of many, particularizing, defining, settling, certainty, ascertainment.
निर्-˚धारयितृ m. one who settles or decides, Śaṃk.

s: tri, (nirDAryyate sTirIkriyate iti । nir + Df + Ric + karmmaRi ktaH .) kftaniScayaH । yaTA । “kintvanirDAritEkatvAnekatvaviSezasya .” iti vijayarakzitaH ॥
m: निर्-˚धारित mfn. determined, ascertained, settled, accurately stated or told, ib.
a: निर्धारित — p. p. Determined, ascertained, fixed, settled, &c.

m: निर्-˚धारितव्य and निर्-˚धार्य, mfn. = ˚धारणीय.
निर्—धार्तराष्ट्र mfn. having no descendants of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, free from them, MBh.

a: निर्धार्य — a. 1 Ascertainable. --2 Resolute, energetic. --3 Bold, fearless, actively working.

s: tri, (nirDriyate iti । nir + Df + “fhalorRyat .” 3 । 1 । 124 । iti Ryat । DAri + Ryat vA .) nirDAraRIyam । nirDAritavyam । nirBayakarmmakarttA । iti viSezyaniGne nirvAryyaSabdawIkAyAM ramAnATaH ॥

m: निर्-√ 1. धाव् P. -धावति, to stream forth or spring or run or escape from (abl.), ŚBr.; Hariv.
a: निर्धाव् — {c1c} P. 1 To wash off or away, cleanse; निर्धोंते सति हरिचंदने जलौघैः Śi. 8. 51; निर्धौतदानामलगंडभित्तिः R. 5. 43, 70. --2 To stream forth, spring from. --3 To run out or escape from.

m: निर्-धाटय Nom. P. ˚यति, to use ill, Śīl.

s: tri, (nir + DAva + karmmaRi ktaH । “cCvoH SUqanunAsike ca .” 6 । 4 । 19 । iti vakArasyoWAdeSaH । “etyeDatyUWsu .” 6 । 1 । 89 । iti vfdDiH .) prakzAlitam । yaTA, -- “tasyAH pAwalapARijANkitamuronidrAkazAye dfSO nirDOto'DaraSoRimA vilulitasrastasfjo mUrdDajAH ॥” iti SrIjayadevaH ॥
m: निर्-धौत (√ 2. धाव्), washed off, cleansed, purified, polished, bright, MBh.; Kāv.
a: निर्धौत — p. p. 1 Washed off, cleansed. --2 Polished, bright.

m: निर्-√ धू P. Ā. -धूनोति, निर्धूनुते, to shake, agitate, shake out or off, scatter, remove, destroy, expel, reject, Br.; MBh.; R. &c.
a: निर्धू — {c5c} {c9c} U. 1 To shake or throw off, remove, dispel, expel, destroy; निर्धूतोऽधरशोणिमा Gīt. 12; ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः Bg. 5. 17; R. 12. 57. --2 To spurn, treat with contempt, disregard. --3 To abandon, forsake, throw away. --4 To repudiate, disown, reject. --5 To afflict, torment, distress. --6 To move about, brandish.

m: निर्—धूम mfn. smokeless, Mālatīm.
निर्—धूम—त्व n., DevībhP.
निर्-˚धूनन n. heaving, fluctuating (of the sea), Kum.

s: tri, (nir + DU + ktaH .) svaRqitam । (yaTA, mArkaRqeye । 85 । 74 । “keSAkarzaRanirDUtagOravA mA gamizyasi ॥”) parityaktam । yaTA, jyotizatattve । “nityaM nirDUtabudDiM prabalaripuBayaM vittanASaYca jIvaH ॥” (nirastam । yaTA, aDyAtmarAmAyaRe । 1 । 3 । “paWanti ye nityamananyacetasaH SfRvanti cADyAtmakasaMjYitaM SuBam । rAmAyaRaM sarvvapurARasammataM nirDUtapApA harimeva yAnti te ॥”) Bartsitam । yaTA, ramAyaRe । 4 । 8 । 32 । “purAhaM vAlinA rAma ! rAjyAt svAdavaropitaH । paruzARi ca saMSrAvya nirDato'smi balIyasA ॥”)
m: निर्-˚धूत mfn. shaken, agitated &c., Mn.; MBh. &c. (also -धुत)
harassed, tormented, R.
deprived or bereft of (comp.), Hariv.
suffered, undergone, W.
निर्-˚धूत m. a man abandoned by his relatives or friends, ib.
a: निर्धूत — p. p. 1 Shaken off, removed; dispelled. --2 Deserted; rejected. --3 Deprived of, bereft. --4 Avoided. --5 Refuted. --6 Destroyed. --7 Broken, divided. --8 Suffered, undergone. --9 Cast off or away, thrown away. --तः A man deserted by his relations and friends.

m: निर्-˚धूत—पाप mfn. one whose sins are wholly shaken off or removed, MW.
निर्-˚धूत—सक्तु mfn. (निर्-ध्˚) (bag) having the barley-meal shaken out, ŚBr.
निर्-√ धम् (ध्मा) P. -धमति, to blow away, blow out of RV.; TĀr.; Suśr.
निर्—√ धम् to drive away from (abl.), Baudh. iv, 1, 20
निर्—धमन n. expulsion, ib. i, 18, 18
निर्—ध˚नी-√ भू (Kull.) to become poor.
निर्—ध˚नी-√ कृ (Daś.) to make poor

s: puM, (nirgataM DanaM yasmAt .) jaradgavaH । iti SabdacandrikA ॥ DanaSUnye, tri । yaTA, -- “brahmahApi naraH pUjyo yasyAsti vipulaM Ganam । SaSinastulyavaMSo'pi nirDanaH pariBUyate ॥” iti cARakye । 82 ॥
m: निर्—धन mfn. without property, poor, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(an enterprise) undertaken without money, Cāṇ.
निर्—धन m. an old bull, L.
निर्—धन—ता f. (Mṛcch.) poverty, indigence
निर्—धन—त्व n. (MBh.; Pañc.) poverty, indigence
निर्—धर्˚मार्थ mfn. unjust and useless, MBh.
निर्—धर्म mfn. unrighteous, lawless, impious, Kathās.
‘unpropertied’, Kap. (-त्व n.)
निर्—धर्म m. unrighteousness, in ˚म-मूर्खता f. unr˚ and foolishness, Kathās.
निर्—धर्म-मूर्खता f., unr˚ and foolishness, Kathās.
निर्—धर्म—त्व n.

s: tri, (nirgato Darmmo yasmAt .) DarmmarahitaH । yaTA, -- “mahAparADe nirDarmme kftaGne klIvakutsite । nAstikavrAtyadAsezu koSapAnaM vivarjjayet ॥” iti mitAkzarA ॥

m: निर्-√ धे -धयति, to drink or suck up, absorb, AV.; ŚBr.

निर्-√ धृ (only Pass. aor. -अधारि, Śiś. ix, 20), to settle, ascertain: Caus. -धारयति, to hold back (the breath), VPrāt., Sch.; to take or pick out, particularize (determine Pass. pres. p. -धार्यमाण), Pāṇ. ii, 3, 42, Sch.: Desid. of Caus. -दिधारयिषति, to wish to ascertain or define, Śaṃk.
a: निर्धृ — {c1c} P., {c10c} U. 1 To determine accurately, settle, fix; निर्धारितेऽर्थे लेखेन खलूक्त्वा खलु वाचिकं Śi. 2. 70; 9. 20. --2 To specify, particularize. --3 To take out from.

m: निर्-˚धृति v.l. for विधृति, VP.

v: nir + DmA--Ric--BAve lyuw । sucutokte SalyodDaraRArTe vyApAraBede “SalyodDAreRahetUpakrame “pramArjanaM nirDmApanaM vamanam” ityAdinA viBajya “AhAraSezaSleDmahInAnuSalyAni SvasanotkAsanapraDamErnirDamet” suSru॰ ।
m: निर्-ध्मापन n. (निर्-√ धम्) blowing away, Suśr.
निर्-˚ध्यात mfn. thought of, meditated, MW.
निर्-√ ध्यै (pres. p. -ध्यायत्, Rājat.; ind.p. -ध्याय, R.), to think of, reflect upon,
